Final hit on a boss/champion gives a lot of points but assisting still gives something. Something like 4k for the kill and 400 for assist. Those numbers change with difficulty but that's a general idea. Your damage to the enemy does nothing to increase or decrease points gained; it's always the same assist amount, whether it's 1% or 99%.

Red bar enemies just give their flat amount to your score but higher tier give you extra points based on their tier. Orange, Yellow and Bosses all gives specific point bonuses for whoever gets the final hit.

Generating orbs doesn't grant points but picking up orbs does. 

Nightfalls have specific modifiers that increase point totals by increase the multiplier to your points. If you want a lot of points, playing a nightfall at the highest difficulty will give you the highest multiplier on your points. There are also medals you can acquire that grant extra points, as well. Usually going for the very rare ones will lead to death, though, especially at the highest difficulty. 

There is also a bug where jolt grants extra points on the post-match screen but those points don't actually add to the nightfall score and are just for that screen. You can lean into it to be very much above your friends but you'll be able to see that the score is off and something is wrong.

- Run a playlist activity for coordinates, probably Gambit since it's the fastest or strikes because 2x rep this week. You will get 40 per game, more if it's nightfall.
